items.raw_excerpt: St. Alphonsa of India (1910–1946) was born Anna Muttathupadathu in Kerala, India, and became a Franciscan Clarist nun whose life was marked by deep prayer, humility, and heroic acceptance of suffering.
items.summary_en: St. Alphonsa was born in Kerala, India in 1910. She became a Franciscan Clarist nun. Her life was known for deep prayer, humility, and accepting suffering with courage.
items.summary_ko: 성 알폰사는 1910년 인도 케랄라에서 태어났습니다. 그녀는 프란치스코 클라라 수녀회의 수녀로 살았습니다. 기도와 겸손한 삶, 그리고 고통을 담담히 받아들이는 용기로 기억되고 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Kleingarten culture is a unique part of life in Germany, offering a small green oasis amidst the urban sprawl. If you're hoping to secure your own allotment, here's what to know about the process and costs - and what to expect when you get one.
items.summary_en: Allotment gardens are a special part of life in Germany. They give city people a small green place to relax. Here is how to get one, what it costs, and what to expect.
items.summary_ko: 주말농원은 독일 생활의 특별한 한 부분입니다. 도시에 사는 사람들에게 작고 푸른 쉼터를 제공해 줍니다. 분양받는 방법과 비용, 그리고 얻고 나면 기대할 수 있는 것들을 소개합니다.
items.title_en: What is a German Kleingarten and how do I get one?

items.raw_excerpt: This French expression can be used both at the table and in plenty of other scenarios.
items.summary_en: Avoir du pain sur la planche means 'to have bread on the board'. The French use this saying when they have a lot of work to do. You can use it at the dinner table and in many other situations.

items.title_en: French Expression of the Day: Avoir du pain sur la planche

items.raw_excerpt: Detroit Tigers infielder Lee Hao-yu (李灝宇) on Saturday recorded his 54th hit of the ongoing 2026 Major League Baseball (MLB) season, tying the single-season record for hits by a Taiwanese MLB player.
items.summary_en: Taiwanese infielder Lee Hao-yu tied the single-season record for hits by a Taiwanese MLB player on Saturday. He recorded his 54th hit of the 2026 MLB season. Lee plays for the Detroit Tigers.

items.title_en: Tigers' Lee ties Taiwanese MLB player single-season record for hits at 54
